scope: Complete touch flight and first-person movement, simultaneous axes and interruption recovery, independently collapsible and reopenable creation tools, clear Create/Explore boundaries, usable keyboard focus and phone portrait/landscape controls with consistent custom styling.

intuitiveness.evidence: The corrected movement pad, explicit Rise/Descend controls, independently reopened Tools drawer and Create/Explore labels are legible in the inspected 360 px portrait and 640 x 360 landscape captures. The actual 07 journey supports keyboard focus, Escape recovery, touch release and mode separation. However, the user's physical phone reaches 100% download while Preparing your workspace never resolves and Create this World stays disabled. That entry journey gives neither a usable canvas nor an actionable explanation, so the complete mobile experience remains substantially incomplete.

accuracy.evidence: Source inspection and the 48 successful builder Pascal/CDP checks provide meaningful coverage of actual Fly/Walk movement, simultaneous axes, cancellation, released pointer deletion, keyboard input, camera changes, responsive hit tests and drawer behavior. The Walk fixture clears real terrain through the authoring UI before measuring real player displacement. These are emulated touch viewports on a desktop GTX 1080, not evidence that the affected physical phone can initialize. The user-reported failure takes precedence over those successes. Its root cause is not established. The generated host's progress covers the data ZIP only; subsequent WASM failures may be caught and logged without a user-visible failure. Browser feasibility cannot receive B+ until that path is diagnosed and the affected startup is demonstrated working.

wowFactor.evidence: The inspected controls preserve the custom Phanes ivory, sage and dark surface treatment, with clear directional marks and a practical increase in visible world space when Tools collapses. The new short-landscape arrangement avoids the prior Tools/Rise overlap, and the narrow portrait action grid restores Clear/Undo/Redo visibility. Those are convincing improvements once initialized, but a phone that stops before creation cannot deliver the complete demonstration. This grade does not assess general world rendering, all visual styles or physical-phone frame rate.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: A shared Pascal input controller joins touch and keyboard axes with explicit held-input ownership, normalized flight and collision-aware walking. A drawer that reopens without changing Explore into Create makes inspection and movement coexist with authoring, and camera-specific vertical controls plus cancellation on covering panels address practical mobile constraints. These are useful combinations with visible and behavioral evidence, though they do not remove the separate startup blocker.

blockingFindings: MN-01: Diagnose and correct the physical-phone startup failure reported during this review. Preserve the affected URL/build, browser/device and startup-stage/error evidence. Verify the affected phone reaches the first rendered-ready acknowledgement, enables Create this World and completes creation followed by Fly and First person input. Repeating the current desktop Chromium emulation alone does not close this observed failure. Keep the complete registered mobile scope unchanged.

MN-02: Make post-download startup progress and failure actionable. The served generated host reports 100% for phanes_data.zip before fetching/instantiating phanes.wasm; ready is published only by TMainView.RenderOverChildren. Its WASI environment catches run exceptions and console.error's them, while load/instantiate failures can invoke unset callbacks and resolve false. Connect supported lifecycle/error callbacks or inspect the actual host failure descriptor, covering caught failures as well as window errors/rejections. Keep creation disabled until genuine readiness; do not manufacture readiness or hide a failed runtime. Add bounded failure evidence and a visible recovery path, then re-review the actual successful phone startup.

MN-03: Register the authored startup implementation and its relevant build/runtime contracts in the existing feature inputs when that correction lands. Retain the current failed report and request a new numbered review with current fingerprints; do not promote this report using only the existing emulation evidence.
